references.title: The Global E-waste Monitor 2024: Electronic Waste Rising, but Recycling Falling Behind
references.authors: Baldé, C. P., Forti, V., Gray, V., Kuehr, R., & Stegmann, P.
references.notes: Primary reference for global e-waste generation statistics (62 Mt in 2022), collection rates (22.3%), category classifications, and critical raw material stocks in urban mining.

references.title: Prospecting Secondary Raw Materials in the Urban Mine and Mining Wastes (ProSUM)
references.authors: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) Consortium
references.notes: Standardized characterization of material composition fractions (ferrous, non-ferrous, precious metals, plastics, battery chemistry) across WEEE categories.

references.title: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 and Technical Guidelines for Recyclers
references.authors: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC) / Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)
references.notes: Mandates classification codes (ITEW1-ITEW17, CEEW1-CEEW3), Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) credit framework, authorized collection protocols, and formal recycling recovery quotas.

references.title: Waste Reduction Model (WARM) - Electronics Chapters and Documentation
references.authors: United States Environmental Protection Agency (US EPA)
references.organization: US EPA Office of Resource Conservation and Recovery
references.notes: Lifecycle inventory methodology for greenhouse gas emissions comparing virgin raw material smelting versus secondary dismantling and hydrometallurgical recycling.

references.title: Estimating the quantities of critical metals in electronic devices and assessing their recycling potential
references.authors: Chancerel, P., Meskers, C. E. M., Haag, O., & Rotter, V. S.
references.notes: Empirical breakdown of printed circuit board (PCB) fractions, gold (Au), silver (Ag), palladium (Pd), and tantalum yields in laptops and smartphones.

references.title: Recycling of Critical Metals from Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment: State of the Art and Industrial Reality
references.notes: Provides industrial metallurgical recovery efficiency factors (75%-85% for precious metals in high-grade smelters) and primary vs secondary carbon intensity.

references.title: Product Environmental Reports: MacBook Pro, iPhone 14/15, iPad 10th Gen
references.notes: Empirical unit weights, recycled aluminum enclosure content, battery mass percentage, and LCA cradle-to-grave disclosures.

references.title: Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) Declarations: Latitude 5420, UltraSharp Monitors
references.notes: Manufacturer bill of materials, product shipping weights, and baseline carbon footprints for commercial notebooks and monitors.
